projects.title: AI Document Assistant
projects.subtitle: Grounded Document Question Answering with RAG
projects.description: A local retrieval-augmented generation application that lets users upload documents and ask questions answered only from the retrieved content.
projects.fullDescription: AI Document Assistant is a full-stack RAG application for searching private documents with natural language. Users can upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown files through a Streamlit interface. A FastAPI backend extracts and chunks the content, creates OpenAI embeddings, and stores them in a local FAISS vector index. When a question is asked, the app retrieves relevant chunks and returns a grounded answer with source excerpts and page information where available.

features.title: Multi-format Uploads
features.description: Ingest PDF, DOCX, TXT, and Markdown documents.

features.title: Grounded RAG Answers
features.description: Answers are generated from retrieved document context and decline unsupported questions.

features.title: Source Citations
features.description: Shows the source document, page when available, and an excerpt for each answer.

features.title: Local Vector Search
features.description: Persists embeddings and document metadata locally with FAISS.

challenges.title: Reliable Retrieval
challenges.description: Finding relevant context across varied document formats.
challenges.solution: Used recursive chunking, OpenAI embeddings, and FAISS similarity search.

challenges.title: Answer Grounding
challenges.description: Reducing unsupported answers when relevant context is missing.
challenges.solution: Applied a strict prompt and surfaced retrieved sources alongside responses.

results: Includes API, chat UI, tests, and Docker setup

projects.title: MatchWise
projects.subtitle: AI Resume Screener & Job-Match Ranking System
projects.description: A Flask application that ranks uploaded resumes against a job description and explains each candidate's matched skills and gaps.
projects.fullDescription: MatchWise is an assistive resume-screening application designed to make job-match analysis transparent. It accepts multiple PDF, DOCX, and TXT resumes, extracts structured information about skills, experience, and education, then ranks candidates against a supplied job description. The scoring combines skill coverage with semantic relevance using Sentence-Transformers, with a TF-IDF fallback when the embedding model is unavailable. It presents matched skills and gaps to support human review rather than automated hiring decisions.

images.caption: Resume screening and candidate ranking interface

features.title: Explainable Scores
features.description: Combines skill coverage and semantic relevance in a transparent weighted score.

features.title: Skill-Gap Feedback
features.description: Highlights matched skills and missing requirements for each candidate.

features.title: Resilient Matching
features.description: Falls back to TF-IDF matching when semantic embeddings are unavailable.

challenges.description: Extracting useful text from PDF, DOCX, and plain-text resumes.
challenges.solution: Implemented dedicated extraction paths for every supported format.

challenges.title: Fair, Understandable Matching
challenges.description: Making ranking results interpretable for human reviewers.
challenges.solution: Exposed matched skills, gaps, and the components of the weighted match score.

results: Ranks candidates with an explainable weighted score

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Engine
projects.subtitle: End-to-End Customer Retention Intelligence
projects.description: An end-to-end machine-learning application that trains churn models, exposes predictions through FastAPI, and visualizes at-risk customer segments in Streamlit.
projects.fullDescription: Customer Churn Prediction Engine is a complete customer-retention analytics workflow. It generates synthetic customer data for immediate experimentation, engineers behavioural and account features, and compares Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost with five-fold stratified evaluation. The best model is persisted for FastAPI predictions, while a Streamlit dashboard supports individual scoring and exploration of at-risk customer segments. The project can also be trained with real CSV data that follows the expected schema.

images.caption: At-risk customer segments and model insights

features.title: Feature Engineering
features.description: Builds churn signals from recency, usage, engagement, support, payment, spend, tenure, and contracts.

features.title: Model Comparison
features.description: Evaluates Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost with stratified cross-validation.

features.title: Prediction API
features.description: Serves persisted-model churn predictions through a FastAPI endpoint.

features.title: Risk Dashboard
features.description: Provides individual scoring and at-risk segment exploration in Streamlit.

challenges.title: Reproducible Training
challenges.description: Making the project runnable without private production data.
challenges.solution: Included a synthetic data generator and a documented CSV training workflow.

challenges.title: Balanced Model Evaluation
challenges.description: Comparing candidate models beyond a single accuracy metric.
challenges.solution: Used five-fold stratified evaluation with ROC-AUC, average precision, precision, and recall.

results: Includes synthetic-data generation for immediate use
Delivers predictions through an API and interactive dashboard

projects.title: Real-Time Object Detection & Tracking
projects.subtitle: Live Multi-Object Detection, Tracking & Footfall Counting
projects.description: A CPU-friendly computer-vision application that detects and tracks objects in live video streams and counts directional crossings over a virtual line.
projects.fullDescription: Real-Time Object Detection & Tracking combines YOLOv8 object detection with class-aware IoU and centroid tracking to maintain persistent object IDs across video frames. It supports webcam, video-file, and RTSP sources, overlays annotations on the feed, and counts directional crossings over a configurable virtual line for footfall analytics. A lightweight Flask application exposes a live MJPEG stream alongside health, status, and detection JSON endpoints. CPU-conscious defaults such as frame resizing and optional frame skipping make the system practical for local use.

images.caption: Live object detection and tracking feed

challenges.title: Real-Time CPU Performance

challenges.solution: Combined class-aware IoU matching with centroid-based tracking.

projects.title: Codeverb
projects.subtitle: Personal Portfolio & Professional Showcase
projects.description: A modern, SEO-optimized personal portfolio website that presents projects, services, skills, certifications, and contact information through a polished responsive interface.
projects.fullDescription: Codeverb is my personal portfolio website, created to showcase my development work and make it easy for visitors to explore project case studies, services, skills, and certifications. The site is built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, with a responsive Tailwind CSS interface and accessible Radix UI components. It includes client-side routing with SEO-friendly project URLs, dynamic metadata, structured data, sitemap generation, social sharing tags, dark and light modes, and smooth page transitions.
